summary: Tested the new multi-admin feature end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases passed (list requires auth, primary admin flagged is_self, weak-password 400, create+login+duplicate+delete flow, cannot-delete-self 400). Frontend: full Playwright flow passed - login as primary admin, open Administradores tab with primary shown as '(tú)' and no self-delete button, weak-password creation shows error toast and no row added, valid creation adds row with success toast, newly created admin can log out and log in with its own credentials, delete removes it from list, other tabs (Galería / Textos / Mensajes) continue to render.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/admin/admins/{email} path-parameter uses raw email; current encodeURIComponent on the frontend handles '@' fine but if an email ever contains '/' it would 404. Low risk.
No rate limiting / audit log for admin creation+deletion - consider logging who created/deleted which admin.
seed_data_creation: A throwaway admin test_<uuid>@example.com was created and deleted during both backend and UI tests; DB is clean (verified 'Administradores (1)' after cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admins.py covers the admins CRUD endpoints. BASE_URL must be exported from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest (there is no default).
